meta.name: Goodbye Earth
meta.description: As an asteroid hurtles towards Earth with nothing to stop it, one determined teacher fights to keep her former students safe — no matter the cost.

videos.title: Football, Bloody Hell!
videos.overview: Traumatized by a tragedy that keeps haunting her, Jin Se-kyung vows to keep her loved ones safe and plots revenge against the perpetrators.

videos.title: Love Is Back
videos.overview: Suspecting Se-kyung's role in the latest murder, Kang In-a gives her a warning. But as Se-kyung plans her next move, a surprising visitor greets her.

videos.title: I Have Butterflies...
videos.overview: Ha Yun-sang's friends celebrate his sudden return, despite the mystery surrounding it. Meanwhile, Se-kyung realizes she's being watched.

videos.title: Felix Culpa
videos.overview: Se-kyung confides in In-a about the ominous threats she's been receiving. The two later embark on a dangerous mission to confront the criminal.

videos.title: The Girl with a Cat
videos.overview: Despite her recent win, Se-kyung still worries that the threat isn't over. Yun-sang receives an enigmatic proposal involving important missing figures.

videos.title: Much Ado About Nothing
videos.overview: Disorder during the joint memorial Mass leads to chaos at the church, increasing criticism and scrutiny into the whereabouts of Father Baek.

videos.title: Arirang; Gone, but Not Forgotten
videos.overview: Se-kyung discovers more about a mysterious training center, and pleads with In-a to investigate it. They soon find darker secrets lie within the building.

videos.title: Dum Spiro Spero
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the raid, the group encounters pushback from authorities — but they uncover more disturbing details about Father Baek's activities.

videos.title: Silver Lining
videos.overview: Se-kyung and Yun-sang finally confront Father Baek, who in turn leaves them with a choice, forcing Se-kyung to ask Yun-sang an impossible question.

videos.title: Exodus, Eclipsed
videos.overview: On the day of the evacuation, Se-kyung and her friends coordinate a plot to get the children to safety. But pandemonium ensues as the plane approaches.

videos.title: Last Christmas
videos.overview: Accepting the fate of the asteroid, everyone tries to carry on with their lives. But the harsh and grim realities of their last days set in.

videos.title: Goodbye Earth
videos.overview: With less than 20 days left, survivors solemnly brace for the asteroid. However, Se-kyung remains steadfast in her mission to protect the children.

meta.slogan: We await the end to come.
